text:
Rae: quick check after the design sync 1 1 uploaded a tiny mock. main asks: where should the latency badge live so it's clearly tied to a model, and how do we surface pinned versions without adding visual noise? figma: https://figma.redwood/mock/mini-catalog

Tom: put the badge left of the model name, small text + icon e.g., "P99 120ms". color + icon helps color-blind folks. avoid a separate metrics column for this metric.

Anika: a11y nits: current badge color fails contrast (3.0:1). aim for >=4.5:1 and include explicit text. for pinning, make the pin keyboard-focusable and announce state changes with aria-live.

Rae: on pin UI: thinking a thin second line under the name: "v2.3   pinned 2025-11-02" and reveal a pin icon on hover/focus to edit. default remains latest.

Tom: also keep compare checkboxes sticky left and show a small floating CTA like "Compare (2)" when selections >=2. keyboard users need tab order to land on that CTA.

design-bot: reminder: product a11y checklist requires 44px touch targets, visible focus outlines, and aria-labels for non-text controls.

Rae: great, i'll update frames with badge-left + P99 label, timestamp-line for pinned, sticky checkboxes + floating compare CTA, and the accessibility fixes. will ping for final pass. :thumbsup:
